title: MSquantSim
summary: MSquantSim is a framework for generating realistic simulated mass spectrometry-based protein abundance datasets to optimize experimental design in quantitative proteomics, offering copula-based, per-protein, and deep-learning simulation approaches for case studies in cancer and single-cell proteomics. It calls SDV's TVAESynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata (via sdv.single_table/sdv.metadata) as one of its generative approaches, alongside a standalone copulas.multivariate.GaussianMultivariate model.
evidence: code/simulate.py:99-106 imports sdv.single_table.TVAESynthesizer, fits it; copula.ipynb uses copulas.multivariate.GaussianMultivariate directly
